summary: Iteration 271: Turkish Bordro PDF Generation feature fully tested. All 24 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified - both PDF and CSV buttons visible to admin in Operations Hub > Shifts tab with correct styling and positioning.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/payroll/preview/{property_id}?month=YYYY-MM returns correct TR Labor Law deduction breakdown (brut/sgk/issizlik/gelir_vergisi/damga_vergisi/net)
Deduction math verified: SGK 14%, İşsizlik 1%, Gelir Vergisi 15% (of tax base), Damga Vergisi 0.759%
Net calculation: net = brut - sgk - issizlik - gelir_vergisi - damga_vergisi (within 1 cent tolerance)
Custom rates via query params (sgk=0.20 etc) correctly override default rates
GET /api/payroll/export-pdf/{property_id}?month=YYYY-MM returns valid PDF (Content-Type: application/pdf, %PDF- magic header)
PDF has Content-Disposition attachment with .pdf filename
PDF returns 404 with Turkish detail message when no completed shifts in period
Both preview and PDF endpoints require admin/manager role (401/403 for non-auth)
Existing CSV endpoint /api/payroll/export still works (regression verified)
Frontend: data-testid='shift-export-payroll-pdf' button visible in Operations Hub > Shifts tab
Frontend: data-testid='shift-export-payroll-csv' button visible alongside PDF button
Frontend: canSeePay check correctly restricts buttons to admin/manager roles only
PDF button styling: bg-rose-600 with Turkish title 'Aylık TR Bordro PDF (4857/5510 sayılı kanunlara uygun)'
Both buttons positioned side-by-side on same row
seed_data_creation: Used existing shift data from May 2026 (property_id='all', month='2026-05')
